new frame versus adjacent original rack supports
proof: Rigid rotation radial norm is invariant; norm is convex in the gate translation, so the endpoints bound its stroke. For tilt0..90deg: x*cos(theta)-y*sin(theta)>=-hypot(max(0,-xmin),max(0,ymax)). Empty tilt holds radius2.32; upright return has radius>=1.65. This is a conservative plane separation bound.
